title: India's solar surge, in numbers
hook_type: surprising verified ranking (open loop: which two countries?)

beats.text: Only two countries made more solar power than India.
beats.on_screen_text: Only two countries made more solar power

beats.text: That's 2025 data from Ember, compiled by Our World in Data.
Solar supplied just 0.54% of India's electricity.
Its solar plants generated about 7 terawatt-hours that year.
By 2025, that had climbed to about 196 terawatt-hours.
Solar's share of India's power rose to 9.4%.
The only two countries ahead of India? China and the United States.
Still, coal produced about 71% of India's electricity, and renewables about 24%.
Have you seen solar panels spreading where you live?
